result.reasoning_summary: Repair commit adds all three required test cases for Evidence reference boundary validation: duplicate detection (replay), cross-tenant isolation, and wrong-kind reference rejection. Test cases use consistent parametrized format, target correct error code (EVIDENCE_REFS_INVALID), and cover critical fail-closed security boundaries. Patch is narrow, test-only, no implementation changes, no network or authority exposure. Deterministic checks pass. FW-SUPPLY-004 vulnerability boundaries (canonical vulnerability/catalog/signature/Evidence binding, cross-tenant isolation, reference-kind validation) are now properly tested.
